title: Planned repository change set
$comment: What a model can honestly propose. A lock file is not on that list: its integrity hashes come from a resolver, so the plan names the manifest to resolve and a deterministic stage produces the lock. The final change-set.schema.json is what carries resolved content.

allOf.$comment: A plan that reports it is blocked has nothing to apply. Letting it carry changes anyway is how a refusal still writes to the repository.
A plan that proposes changes has to say what it asked the resolver to produce, even when the answer is nothing. A plan that proposes nothing has nothing to declare.
